item.title: Area students compete in Southeast Missouri Job Olympics in Jackson
item.description: JACKSON, Mo. (KBSI) — High school students from across southeast Missouri gathered Friday at the Jackson Civic Center to compete in the Southeast Missouri Job Olympics. The event features competitions designed to simulate real-world job tasks, including stocking shelves, sorting laundry and cleaning building areas such as vacuuming and sweeping. item.title: Flooding closes portion of Highway BB in Jefferson County
item.description: JEFFERSON COUNTY, Mo. (KBSI) — A portion of Highway BB between Cedar Hill and Hillsboro is closed due to flooding, according to the Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office. item.title: Cape Girardeau Noon Lions Club to host 88th annual Pancake Day
item.description: CAPE GIRARDEAU, Mo., (KBSI) — The Cape Girardeau Noon Lions Club will host its 88th annual Pancake Day on March 18 at the A.C. Brase Arena Building in Cape Girardeau.
